caption: The drawing depicts a circular object resembling a rose window or ornate wheel, centered on a cream-colored background. The circle is bordered by a thick brown ring with a black inner edge. Inside the circle, an intricate symmetrical pattern radiates from the center, forming eight main sections that repeat around the circumference. The design consists of stylized, organic shapes reminiscent of leaves and floral motifs, all interconnected, and rendered in a light beige color, with deep black cut-out spaces creating a stark contrast and emphasizing the pattern. Around the edge of the design, there is a jagged, saw-tooth shaped ring. Fine black lines are visible on the background, marking out construction lines and a smaller circle in the upper left corner. The bottom right of the background contains handwritten text, including the name "Vincent P. Rossi," a date "Del. 1981," and a smaller notation "A2 1900" inside the circular design.
title: Valentine
